Regenerate Gradle dependency lockfiles

Produced by the refresh-locks workflow. Lockfiles cannot be generated in the development sandbox:
it has no Android SDK, and its JVM cannot start at all under the PaX/W^X restriction that blocks
marking memory pages executable.

Kept in a file rather than inline in the workflow because a multi-line -m argument inside a YAML
run block breaks the document parse — GitHub then registers the workflow with no name and no
triggers, and rejects every dispatch with "Workflow does not have 'workflow_dispatch' trigger".
